title: limniris hartwegii
intro: Limniris hartwegii, commonly known as Mexican gentian, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, due to its health benefits of promoting digestive health and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Limniris hartwegii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating infections and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Limniris hartwegii include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
